raw_text: `entities/` clients; `models/` API types; `pkg/` utilities; `examples/` runnable; `docs/` docs; `scripts/` helpers. Root: `Makefile`, `go.mod`, `.env.example`, `PLAN.md`. Commands: `make set-env`, `make test`, `make test-fast`, `make coverage`, `make lint`, `make fmt`, `make tidy`, `make verify-sdk`, `go build ./...`, `make docs`, `make demo-data`, `make godoc`; Go 1.24.x. Run `make fmt` before committing. Never commit secrets. No panics in library code. Run `make fmt lint test verify-sdk` before opening a PR. Minimum 80% coverage. Keep changes minimal/scoped; update `PLAN.md` for milestones/flags. Verify generators/examples with `make demo-data`; document flags in `docs/`.
